summary: Iteration 171: Ticket Console Header + Change Customer Flow - All backend tests passed (14/14). Frontend verified: TicketConsoleHeader renders with all elements (Back, ID badge, Priority badge, Status badge, Title, Reply, Resolve, More dropdown). Change Customer dialog works with search, client list, 'current' badge, reason textarea, and Reassign button. Status pipeline (5 steps) visible. Customer history audit comments visible in conversation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ticket Console Header and Change Customer flow fully functional. Backend endpoints: POST /api/tickets/{id}/change-customer (reassigns ticket, adds history entry, posts audit comment), GET /api/tickets/{id}/customer-history (returns history array), POST /api/tickets/{id}/revert-customer (reverts to previous customer). Frontend: TicketConsoleHeader component renders at top of ticket detail view with all required elements. Change Customer dialog opens from customer pill click. Legacy header hidden by default (toggle via Layout menu).

backend_endpoints.change_customer: POST /api/tickets/{id}/change-customer - validates client_id (400 if empty, 404 if unknown), returns no_change:true if same client, creates history entry, posts audit comment with kind='customer_changed', clears contact if not provided
backend_endpoints.customer_history: GET /api/tickets/{id}/customer-history - returns array of history entries with id, ts, from_client_id, from_client_name, to_client_id, to_client_name, changed_by, reason
backend_endpoints.revert_customer: POST /api/tickets/{id}/revert-customer - reverts to previous customer using last history entry's from_client_id, returns 400 if no history
backend_endpoints.ticket_update: PUT /api/tickets/{id} - updates status and title correctly

frontend_components.ticket_console_header: data-testid='ticket-console-header' - renders at top of ticket detail with Back button, ID badge, Priority badge, Status badge, Title (click-to-edit), Reply button, Resolve button, More dropdown
frontend_components.customer_pill: data-testid='customer-pill' - shows client_name with swap icon, opens Change Customer dialog on click
frontend_components.change_customer_dialog: data-testid='change-customer-dialog' - search input (data-testid='change-customer-search'), client list (data-testid='change-cust-row-{id}'), 'current' badge on assigned client, reason textarea, Reassign button (data-testid='change-customer-submit')
frontend_components.status_pipeline: data-testid='pipeline-step-{status}' - 5 steps (open, in_progress, on_hold, resolved, closed), click-to-set status, current step highlighted in emerald
frontend_components.console_title: data-testid='console-title' - click to edit, shows input (data-testid='console-title-input'), Enter saves, Escape cancels
frontend_components.more_dropdown: data-testid='console-more-btn' - contains Transfer, Change customer, Customer history (if exists), C.R.A.I.G, Co-Pilot, Explain error, Voice Journal, Why on fire?, Email, PDF, Billing
frontend_components.customer_history_link: data-testid='customer-history-link' - appears after customer change, shows count of changes
frontend_components.customer_history_dialog: data-testid='customer-history-dialog' - reverse-chronological list, Revert last button (data-testid='revert-customer-btn')
frontend_components.legacy_header: Hidden by default (legacyHeader: false), can be enabled via Layout customise menu

features_verified.audit_trail: Customer change creates audit comment with kind='customer_changed' visible in ticket conversation timeline
